name: Python
description: Python brand mark (two snakes), official brand color.
notes: Official brand colour is defined once in the preamble. Change that one `\definecolor` to make it monochrome.
The path is pre-scaled to about 2.5cm; resize with `[scale=...]` on the tikzpicture.
Imported from [OpenTikZ](https://github.com/opentikz/opentikz) (shape data from simple-icons, CC0).
